constraint_policy.physical_rules: tcprtt = synack + ackdat; TCP-only fields are 0 for non-TCP flows; smean = round(sbytes / spkts); dmean = round(dbytes / dpkts), 0 if dpkts = 0; rate = (spkts + dpkts - 1) / dur (0 if dur = 0), within 1%; sload = (sbytes - smean) * 8 / dur, within 1%; dload = (dbytes - dmean) * 8 / dur, within 1%; sloss <= spkts; dloss <= dpkts; spkts >= 1; sbytes >= 28 * spkts (observed bound, not a protocol rule)

rules.checkpoint_validity: checkpoint rows with checkpoint_valid=False (multi-start below its run budget) are skipped
rules.heldout_both_flag: exceeds_heldout_top10 AND exceeds_heldout_spearman (Part B's primary flag applied to held-out seeds)
rules.no_spoofing_claims: this script reports stability only; it never labels a candidate as successful spoofing
rules.part_b_criterion: the same rules on seeds 11,22,33,44,55 (10 pairs); includes the search seed 11, so NOT held-out
rules.per_metric_rule: for top5_jaccard, top10_jaccard, spearman_rho: exceeds if the candidate's mean (over seeds) is strictly lower than the minimum of the original sample's seed-pair values on the same seeds
rules.primary: heldout_top10_jaccard_mean over held-out seeds 22,33,44,55; shift = 1 - mean; exceeds_heldout_top10 if mean < min of the original's 6 held-out seed-pair top10_jaccard values
rules.search_score_check: objective_score(original, candidate) recomputed under the search LIME seed must equal the saved search score within 1e-09; any mismatch is reported and makes the script exit with an error
rules.top1_rule: original's top-1 agrees in all seed pairs AND candidate's top-1 differs from the original's in >= 3 paired seeds
